steps.content: Sallie returns to the dressing room, physically and mentally drained, her senses dulled.
It isn't until she's changing clothes that she notices something hidden in the shadows behind her—and it just twitched. Sallie's nerves go taut, and she slaps the light switch.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Who's there?... Milly?!
With a soft thunk, Milly scrambles out from under the vanity, rubbing her head where she bumped it before nervously raising a finger to her lips.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Shh... shh... keep your voice down!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: That man... he didn't hurt you, did he? About what happened that night... and... the communicator...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Hm? What are you talking about? I'm fine! See? All healed! It doesn't hurt at all.

Milly waves her hands, and sure enough, her pale arms show no trace of injury. But Sallie knows how the ship "maintains its merchandise." Her own insides still hurt, and she's more worried about Milly. After all, Milly was the one punished that day, and there's no telling what they did to her after she was dragged off.
But Euphoria's star cheerfully changes the subject, easily deflecting any more questions.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: But what about you? Were you scared? Did you have nightmares?
Memories of that night flash through Sallie's mind. The luxurious room, blood-stained carpet, fists raining down on her body... and herself, completely powerless to fight back.

This was different from the humiliations she had endured before. At least in the past, no one had seriously wanted to destroy a beautiful "commodity." But that night... that night... she wasn't even treated as a human. The mere thought of those memories makes Sallie's body go cold and rigid, and she begins to tremble.

Someone grasps her hand. Sallie shudders, looking up to see Milly watching her. There's no question or doubt in her eyes, only a quiet calm, like the surface of a mirror. Slowly, Sallie calms down, and feels the warmth spread from Milly's palm into hers.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...I'm okay. Thank you.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Don't mention it. I know what it's like. When you're most scared, you really need someone to support you. I've been through it too. Now, it's finally my turn to help someone else.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: That person... is the one you've been waiting for? ${PlayerName}, right?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Who is he?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ...Want to hear about it?
Milly stares shyly at her fingertips, tapping them together and pulling them apart. She draws little circles on the floor with her foot. The air seems to thicken with the sweet scent of honey.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: He must be a really good person, right?
steps.female_content: She must be a really good person, right?

steps.content: She's just a little curious... Milly said that person gave her the strength to go on... Sallie wants to know what kind of person could inspire that in a place like this...
[Insert story item: Chief doll]

Something soft is suddenly shoved in Sallie's face, and she recoils in surprise. Looking closer, she sees it's a small cotton doll in a gray trench coat. It's clearly handmade, but with exquisite detail.

The fabric is a bit old, but it's been lovingly cared for. Every detail is clean and neat, the corners of its clothes perfectly straight. It's obviously someone's treasured possession, cherished for a long time.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: This is wonderful! I finally have a friend to talk to about love!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: He's the most amazing person in the whole world! So kind and dependable! The line of people he's helped would stretch all the way from Syndicate to Eastside! And it'd have to wrap around the block three times!
steps.female_content: She's the most amazing person in the whole world! So kind and dependable! The line of people she's helped would stretch all the way from Syndicate to Eastside! And it'd have to wrap around the block three times!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Look! These are the newspaper clippings I've collected! And look! This is his doll and outfit set! And this is the legendary underground film he starred in, Beyond DisCars! I heard it was made by a famous director. He looks so dashing in the film, so gorgeous!
steps.female_content: Look! These are the newspaper clippings I've collected! And look! This is her doll and outfit set! And this is the legendary underground film she starred in, Beyond DisCars! I heard it was made by a famous director. She looks so dashing in the film, so gorgeous!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: If you're interested, I can tell you stories about him for three days and nights. Every one of them is a legend! But... if you hear them all, you'll probably fall in love with him, so...
steps.female_content: If you're interested, I can tell you stories about her for three days and nights. Every one of them is a legend! But... if you hear them all, you'll probably fall in love with her, so...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: No, no, that won't do! You already have someone you love, and besides, I'm not sharing him with anyone!
steps.female_content: No, no, that won't do! You already have someone you love, and besides, I'm not sharing her with anyone!

steps.content: Milly practically glows as she talks about her beloved. Her eyes are shining with stars, and the air seems to shimmer with pink bubbles. Sallie finds herself drowning in a sea of rosy fluff, and wishes more than anything for Milly to stop.
...Oh, whatever. Listening for a little longer won't hurt. As long as it makes her happy.
Sallie regrets this decision. She's bombarded by Milly's stories for what feels like an eternity, until Milly's throat is parched and Sallie's mind begins to wander.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ...Anyway, he's going to come for me, and then we'll live happily ever after!
steps.female_content: ...Anyway, she's going to come for me, and then we'll live happily ever after!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...If I understand correctly, you two have never actually met, have you?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Well, we've met... once?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: And you confessed your love after meeting just once?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Ah, well, I could never say it out loud! It's too embarrassing!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Does he know you're waiting for him?
steps.female_content: Does she know you're waiting for her?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Not yet, but soon! Once I get more famous, someone will definitely tell him!
steps.female_content: Not yet, but soon! Once I get more famous, someone will definitely tell her!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Do you really believe that he'll show up one day, fall in love with you, and take you away?
steps.female_content: Do you really believe that she'll show up one day, fall in love with you, and take you away?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Of course I do!

Sallie covers her face. Is Milly hopelessly romantic or just painfully naive? Is she an Eastsider? Drop Milly anywhere in Eastside and she'd be scammed in a heartbeat! Though... that's not so different from her current situation anyway.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Talking about myself this whole time... Now your turn, Sallie! What's your sweetheart like?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: That's all in the past. I don't want to talk about it...
Memories of that abruptly ended relationship chill her voice.
But when she looks up into Milly's eager eyes, sees the lingering bruises on her skin, Sallie can't bring herself to refuse.
...She'll tell her something. Think of it as making a child happy.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...Alright, alright. His name is Theodore. He used to come in to the bar to watch me dance. Not in a place like this, of course... and not this kind of dancing.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: He's a rich boy from a good family, nothing like a poor dancer such as me. It was his rowdy friends who dragged him into the bar the first time.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: At first, he was so timid he could barely speak straight. He got so flustered trying to talk to me, he'd mess up my name. He came every day, but we never exchanged more than three sentences. He was a complete idiot.
She'd long ago decided to put the past behind her, but speaking of it brings the memories back, vivid before her eyes. Sallie's voice softens.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: But... one day, when I was being harassed by a drunk, he jumped in front of me. He was shaking all over, but he didn't back down an inch. I guess it was... brave of him.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: How touching! If he knew what you were going through here, he'd come rushing to save you!

Does he know? Or does he not care? The last time they saw each other, Theodore had sworn he'd fight for their future, that he'd mustered the courage to go home and make his case. Then, like in every clichéd Eastside romance novel, he never returned.

Faced with a broken promise, Sallie had decisively cut him out of her life. She never trusted those arrogant rich people to begin with; going out with Theodore had just been... a moment of weakness, a lapse in judgment. She isn't some fool who'd fall head over heels for a pretty face.

...But thinking about it now, she really doesn't know what happened to him. Before he left, he'd given her all his money for safekeeping—everything he'd saved trying to make it on his own. It wasn't much, but it wasn't nothing. When the debt collectors came for her, Sallie didn't touch it. She doesn't know why.
Did she want the satisfaction of throwing the goddamned money back in that bastard's face? Or... was there a part of her that still fantasized he'd break free and come back for her?
But right now, there's someone more worried than she is.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oh, he doesn't know? He must be worried sick! No wonder you want to escape so badly... We have to do something fast.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Escape...?

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: What kind of look is that?! What do you think you are?! How dare you look at me like that?!

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: So don't even think about leaving. No one leaves here without my permission. Unless they're dead.
Sallie begins to tremble, and Milly notices. She stops talking and gently takes Sallie's hand.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Sallie. Look at me. Take a deep breath. It'll pass. Everything will pass. I'm here. I told you I'd be on your side, that I'd help you escape—and I meant it.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: But what about you? What will happen to you after you help me? Won't Mr. E...
In her mind's eye, she sees Milly being dragged away by Mr. E again. That suffocating sense of helplessness still makes her blood run cold.
But the person in question doesn't seem to care in the slightest.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It's fine! Mr. E spoils me. He wouldn't really do anything to me. See? Not a single scar left.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Besides, this is an elopement! So romantic, so epic! I've studied many romance movies. It's time to put all that into practice.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Your sweetheart has some status, right? Then we just need to get the word out, let him know you're here. The guests on this ship have their own connections. Someone's bound to be able to reach him!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: And... I have the perfect person to help us—<color=#fb9259>Cassian</color>! He knows more about what goes on aboard this ship than anyone. He's got this!
Milly beams with confidence, one hand balled into a fist to cheer Sallie on. Her hair shines like gold, and for a moment, Sallie is dazzled.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: We've only known each other for a few days... Why are you going so far to help me?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Because of love, of course.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: We're companions with love in our hearts. If leaving this place will bring you happiness, then of course I'll help you.
So many questions remain, so many concerns... but in this dark, suffocating club, Milly's words are like honey and sunshine. Alright, I'll play along. Sallie thinks, finally nodding her head.
The clock in the corner chimes. Milly brushes her skirt and rises to her feet.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Hehe, it's about time. I need to get to work and provide cover for our plan. Don't forget it, okay?
The room feels empty the moment Milly leaves, filling Sallie with unease. She nervously stands up as well.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oh right! I have a gift for you.
She hurries back to Sallie and reaches out a hand, gently brushing her finger across the corner of Sallie's lips.
In that instant, Sallie is enveloped by a familiar sweet fragrance, like the honey dripping on her that night, but different. She feels a strange power enter her body.
Milly withdraws her finger and presses a small golden lip balm into Sallie's hand, flashing a mischievous smile.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Relax. He'll definitely come.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Until then, if any bad guys try to hurt you again, use this lip balm to protect yourself, okay?
